en.askTitle: Put in your own city, savings and trades and compare Portugal and Ireland on what the official pages say
en.runTitle: Brazilian couple, BRL 95,000: Portugal’s CPLP route or an English course in Dublin
en.template: Help me compare moving from {city} to Portugal on a CPLP residence route against studying in {irish}. There are {adults} of us, our savings are {savings}, and our trades are {trades}. Check what the consulate and AIMA currently require for the CPLP visa, whether the school I am considering is on the ILEP or TrustEd list, and whether each spouse can apply separately. Rebuild the six-month budgets with my own rent, flight and food figures, and flag anything unconfirmed. Ask before contacting anyone or paying anything.

phases.judgment: It corrected the starting assumption about Portugal: since Law 61/2025 (in force from 23 October 2025) the job-seeker visa is only for highly qualified work, so the researcher advised that an electrician and an administrative assistant should not plan around it.

phases.judgment: It said which pages it could not read: the Irish immigration pages returned only a title, so the guide cites that wording as indirect, and a conflicting snippet saying English students get no right to work was set aside because the official wording contradicts it.
